message: The other day, I opened my car trunk to grab a few things, and there it was—my little emergency kit, just sitting there all tidy and ready. It reminded me of all those times I thought about being prepared but never quite got around to it. Having that blanket and some essentials gives me such peace of mind. It feels like a small win that can make a big difference, doesn’t it? What little things do you do to stay ready for the unexpected?
scene: a car trunk with a tidy emergency kit and a folded blanket (golden-hour light through a window)
